messages.content: When all_util is high, does its SHAP contribution push predictions up?

content.thinking: I'm going to look into the all_util feature by pulling up its SHAP detail.

There's no direct tool linking feature values to SHAP contributions, but I can infer the trend from the percentile stats: p95, p99, and max are all positive, suggesting high values of all_util tend to push the SHAP contribution upward.

Actually, checking further, these percentiles describe the distribution of SHAP values across rows, not feature values paired with SHAP, so I can't confirm directionality without a tool that correlates feature magnitude with its own SHAP value—no such tool exists here (get_correlated_features only relates features to each other, and get_feature_target_association relates to the outcome, not SHAP). So this question isn't answerable with the given tools; what's missing is a way to condition SHAP values on the feature's own value, like partial dependence.
